text:
matt: hi all, i'm the new oncall rotator starting Thurs. couple quick things before my first shift: PD access, runbooks for common P1s, and a safe place to practice a simulated incident? also who to cc for exec notifications?

lee: welcome! i'm your shadow for first two shifts. add me on PD (lee@redwood.com) and DM with your PD profile id. exec notify goes to #eng-execs and notify@redwood.com (only after 20m and confirmed impact).

emma: runbooks live at https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks. Start with /oncall/triage-quickref and /oncall/p1-database. For practice, we run a 'dry-run' sim the day before each rotation — i'll schedule one. also ensure your KMS access is present for kms:Decrypt on secrets-store if you'll rotate certs.

matt: where do i check KMS role? i tried kubectl get secrets and got forbidden.

lee: KMS roles are in IAM console; ping infra-oncall (infra-oncall@redwood.com) for immediate grant. kubectl forbidden likely missing namespace rolebinding; i'll add you to oncall-viewer role for namespaces prod and staging.

opsbot: OpsBot: Received dry-run sim request for matt. queued for 2024-07-11T17:00:00Z. To run manual test: curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood.internal/sim -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"user":"matt","type":"dry-run"}'

matt: ran the curl and got 401. SSO shows ok.

emma: 401 = token expired or not minted. check `aws sso login` or your corporate SSO session. also confirm ~/.redwood/credentials has a fresh session.

matt: fixed, got 200 and push notification. saw 'SIM: triage db timeout'. joined the scheduled dry-run, thanks.

lee: checklist for first shadow: 1) verify PD contact methods (push + SMS) 2) run sim 3) join zoom for triage walkthrough 4) review escalations (5m ack) 5) confirm exec notify threshold with PM. i'll DM you a short checklist doc.

matt: awesome, appreciating the help — less nervous now :relieved:
